items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: people like Chris Barber, Ken Collier, Acker Bilk, all those guys were kind of getting going

ctx.x: Well did it occur to you at that point that maybe there’s a career for me at some point here?

No. We were just doing this because, it was the time of the English traditional jazz revival, the trad boom, right? That’s the period we’re talking about. Middle ‘50s, before I went into the Army, and it was just about the time that people like Chris Barber, Ken Collier, Acker Bilk, all those guys were kind of getting going, and we were just kind of

bowled over by this. Strictly traditional jazz. I wanted to play traditional jazz. By that time I knew who Kid Ory was and I was aware that that was the kind of jazz music I wanted to have a go at. And we all felt the same, you know, quite purist and just wanted to have a go at it.
